name: Ubooquity
short_desc: Lightweight home server for your comics and ebooks.
author: linuxserver.io
description: Ubooquity is a free, lightweight and easy-to-use home server for your comics and ebooks. Use it to access your files from anywhere, with a tablet, an e-reader, a phone or a computer. It serves a browsable library web UI (port 2202) and a separate admin interface (port 2203) where you configure your library folders and users. This package mounts your books and comics from the shared ${ROOT_FOLDER_HOST}/media root used by the official Runtipi media apps, and runs as 1000:1000 to match the files those apps write.

form_fields.label: Max memory (MB)
form_fields.hint: Optional. Maximum memory Ubooquity may use, in MB. Raise it for very large libraries. Defaults to 512 if left blank.
